title: Choose the look of the app
question: The roll assigned The Photo Studio. Keep it, pick another, or roll again. A text-picture world was dropped: the card needs a real Photo of a face.

options.label: The Photo Studio
options.lineage: Passport photo booth: white backdrop, crop frame, clipboard of details
options.thesis: Every screen is a sitting: the Photo is the work, the Request is the clipboard beside it.
options.viewport: On a phone, the Photo crop fills the top. Name and Matricule sit on the clipboard under it. Send Request is the only big button.
options.risk: Staff may feel they opened a camera app if the queue is not as clear as the Photo.

raised.raise: Photo and fields snap to one module. Nothing floats or scatters.
On a phone, one job owns the screen: Photo, or status, or come collect.
One pull opens a credit-card preview from the Request, then folds back to the form.

options.label: The Register
options.lineage: School matricule attendance book: ruled columns, names, a wet stamp
options.thesis: Open Requests are rows in a school register. The stamp is accept, no, or come collect.
options.viewport: Admin sees a short list of Open Requests as register rows. A Student sees only their own row, with the stamp as status.
options.risk: This is the look most school-desk apps land on: easy to trust, easy to look like every other admin list.

options.label: The Next Sign
options.lineage: Airport yellow wayfinding bands, black type, one decision per panel
options.thesis: The Request path is a chain of signs: only the next step is huge, everything else waits.
options.viewport: A yellow band tells the Student the one next step: send, wait, or come collect. Admin bands say check, Print, or mark Arrival.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the path is unmistakable. Loses on home: SLUI is a campus, not a terminal.
options.risk: Reads as an airport product unless every sign names a real Request step.

options.label: The Darkroom
options.lineage: Printing darkroom: amber safelight, trays, a timer you cannot undo
options.thesis: A Request moves through stations you cannot reverse: fill, Photo, send, accept, Print, Pickup.
options.viewport: The Photo sits in true light, like a print in a tray. Stations along the edge show how far the Request has gone.
options.case: Holds product clarity: sent cannot be taken back. Loses on home: nobody at SLUI works under a safelight.
options.risk: Amber wash must never tint the Photo. Staff have to judge a real face.

options.label: Color Bars
options.lineage: Studio Dumbar: loud color blocks over photographs
options.thesis: Request fields and the Photo snap under stacked color bars.
options.viewport: A Photo sits under a stack of saturated bars. Fields lock to the same module.
options.case: Loses both axes: staff cannot scan a queue through confetti, and SLUI is not a Dutch identity studio.
options.kept: Photo and fields lock to one module.
options.risk: Bars would fight the face on the Photo.

options.label: Gravity Garden
options.lineage: Surreal garden where rain falls by cloud color
options.thesis: Status pulls like local gravity: each Request state has its own fall.
options.viewport: A garden of Request states, each with its own gravity.
options.case: Loses both axes: a garden hides the job, and nobody here lives in one.
options.kept: On a phone, one job owns the screen.
options.risk: Students would not know what to tap.

options.label: The Folded Sheet
options.lineage: Miura-fold packet that opens into a rigid sheet
options.thesis: A draft is a small packet. Send deploys the full Request. You cannot pack it back.
options.viewport: A compact Request packet. One pull opens the card-sized face.
options.case: Loses both axes: folding is a trick on a desk queue, and staff do not fold satellites.
options.kept: One pull opens the card-sized preview.
options.risk: A fold is a poor way to scan tens of Open Requests.

canonCard.label: A normal school admin app
canonCard.thesis: Sidebar, table of Requests, blue buttons. The usual ID-desk layout, done well.
canonCard.viewport: A side list of Open Requests. Click a row. Accept or turn down on the right.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other admin tool on purpose.
